title: Oog
subtitle: Local DuckLake stack: object storage, catalog, Git and a VS Code workbench with aantje.

tools.name: Workbench
tools.description: VS Code in the browser with Jupyter, DuckDB and DuckLake. Open the medallion notebooks (notebooks/local, notebooks/quack for the Quack server, and notebooks/azure for an Azure DuckLake) in the oog-workspace repository and pick the kernel Oog.

tools.name: aantje
tools.description: VS Code extension for browsing the DuckLake catalog and running SQL. The "Oog Lakehouse" connection is preconfigured (activity bar); the password is the Postgres password from .env and is asked for on the first connect.

tools.name: Gitea
tools.description: Git server with LFS. The oog-workspace repository holds the notebooks; sign in with the Gitea admin account from .env.

tools.name: RustFS console
tools.description: S3 object storage: bucket oog-lake holds the DuckLake data files and the raw test data, oog-gitea the Git objects.
